description:
• As part of the SDN/NFV team, the Network Software Developer will be responsible for the development and maintenance of SDN subsystem of network software platform. 
• Design, develop, test and maintain network monitoring, provisioning, and automation systems, with a specific focus on supporting customer facing network products. 
• Work with Network Architecture, Network Engineering, Software Development, NOC, and IT teams to develop requirements and timelines for new features and integration. 
• Coordinate with Application teams to define and implement interfaces between the Business Applications and SDN subsystem. 
• Propose solutions for developing scalable and highly available network software applications used in the management of data center network infrastructure. 

Required Skills and Abilities: 
• Bachelor's Degree or equivalent. 
• 3+ years of development in Java/J2EE, WEB development; Python, Ruby On Rails experience a plus. 
• 3+ years’ experience with SQL and relational databases. 
• 3+ years’ experience with networking devices and network management application development. 
• 2+ years’ experience with defining REST API’s and its implementation. 
• Self-motivated team player. 
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.


 Java/J2EE, WEB development,SQL,Python,Ruby,REST API’s 


 Only GC/Citizen
